title: PhysxTriggerStateAPI
summary: Asks the runtime to report a trigger's current overlaps back to the stage; only its presence is checked and no column is read. Together with PhysxTriggerAPI it marks the shape for overlap output, and the runtime then writes the overlapping colliders to physxTrigger:triggeredCollisions through the data-write sink.

interactions.rule: Without PhysxTriggerAPI on the same collider the API has no effect: only a trigger's overlaps are written.

notes: physxTrigger:triggeredCollisions is output only: the runtime writes it through the data-write sink (to USD on the USD backend) and the parser never reads it, so it is not a column of this contract. Without a write sink nothing is written.
